cards.name: Copper
cards.text: Provide 1 money.

cards.name: Silver
cards.text: Provide 2 money.

cards.name: Gold
cards.text: Provide 3 money.

cards.name: Footwork
cards.text: You may move 1 space left or right. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Cull
cards.text: Trash 1 or 2 cards. Choose Cull itself, cards remaining in your hand, or both.

cards.name: Muster
cards.text: Draw two cards.

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: At Close range, the next Close-range attack this turn deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage. Then move both fighters 1 space left or right so they remain Close. If a wall blocks the move, neither fighter moves, and the attack deals 2 additional damage.

cards.name: Flurry
cards.text: At Close range, deal 1 damage for each other Tactical Action played this turn, to a maximum of 5.

cards.name: Aim
cards.text: At Near or Far range, become Aimed, then draw one card.

cards.name: Volley
cards.text: Deal 1 damage at Near range or 3 damage at Far range. Aimed changes this to 4 or 5.

cards.name: Stipend
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Provide 1 money.

cards.name: Reclaim
cards.text: Draw 1 card. You may put one card from your discard pile on top of your deck.

cards.name: Adapt
cards.text: Draw 1 card. If your position changed during your turn, draw 1 more.

cards.name: Heavy Blow
cards.text: At Close range, deal 4 damage.

cards.name: Quick Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 1 damage. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Steady Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 2 damage.

cards.name: Channel
cards.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card.

cards.name: Ley Step
cards.text: Move 1 space left or right. Gain 1 mana.

cards.name: Prism
cards.text: Gain 2 mana. Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Arc Bolt
cards.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 3 damage at any range.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.text: Spend 2 mana. Deal 6 damage at any range.

cards.name: Starfire
cards.text: Spend 3 mana. Deal 9 damage at any range.

cards.name: Step
cards.text: Move 1 space left or right.

cards.name: Strike
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage.

cards.name: Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 2 damage.
